rule: Pilot samples by a fixed rule (written to <out>/samples.tsv and freeze.json before any search): eligible = every checked run counted in molecules, read type ONT or PacBio HiFi/CCS, no run submitted as an aligned BAM, depth >= 30x (verified bases / assembly length); per genus the eligible sample with the most candidate cores supported in read-check round 5 (ties: depth, then id); genera whose best sample has >= 15 such cores; then HiFi samples by the same score until at least 2 HiFi samples are in. --batch-size N (scale batch): every eligible sample not excluded, all genera, taken genus by genus in turn (genera ordered by their best sample, samples within a genus by the same score), first N. --exclude: samples used in development (earlier batches' samples.tsv files and listed ids) are not eligible (reason used_in_development); the rule is otherwise the same, so a validation batch is the next sample per genus.
